Scope: Rendering evidence and theme-scoped requirements. Audit IDs refer to sanitized technical records; source passes do not imply runtime acceptance.

Profiles.Claim: The policy provides source assignments, not a verified consumer conversion.
The bounded registered editor overrides use opaque Win32 RGB; other consumers and typed values are separate.
Output Current List Location has separate classification foreground and legacy marker background.
Invalid background is removed; a valid raw override uses opaque RGB. Final native merge validity is unknown.
Message foreground is text; Background is its border brush. The interior is transparent over the editor.

Valid raw overrides become opaque brushes; normal selection preserves syntax and applies 0.4 element opacity, then 1.0 layer opacity over the editor. Version-pinned, no inference to High Contrast or overlaps.
The inspected item template uses ToolWindowText and normal/hover/selected backgrounds.
The installed badge and toolbar templates use distinct fill tokens with a shared frame; equality is project policy.
Opaque WPF image background context converted to renderer RGB; does not paint a surface. Only the pinned normal enabled image consumer is supported.

CalculationProfiles.Next: Unify numerical semantics during remediation; do not change calculations in item 2.
Preserve fractional composition; select consumer conversion before calculation in later remediation.
Retain bounded registered RGB checks; overlap remains runtime work.

Requirements.Title: Authoring schema, deterministic generation and explicit bindings
Requirements.Description: The schema/version, thirteen-theme order, formatting and raw-only semantic bindings are local reproducibility constraints. The compiler supports typed components; the generator intentionally supports a subset.
Requirements.Next: Retain generation checks; do not generalize this subset into the complete compiler schema.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Identity, structure, typed payloads and component admission
Requirements.Description: Canonical identities and fixed structure are project constraints. Eight hex digits validate payload shape, not RGB interpretation. CT_INVALID/automatic/index/system values need distinct semantics.
Requirements.Next: Preserve identities and payload types; document CT_COLORINDEX as retained compatibility debt. Do not infer literal RGB from the payload shape.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Cosmora reversible raw-color mappings
Requirements.Description: Bidirectional color mapping is a project identity invariant, not a Microsoft token contract.
Requirements.Next: Retain split/merge guards across all three shifted variants.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Numeric contrast helpers and threshold decisions
Requirements.Description: The older helper rounds blended channels and adds 0.0001 tolerance. The newer helper preserves fractional channels and compares directly. An actual helper probe changes a 4.4916975 failure into a 4.5144298 pass.
Requirements.Next: Use one consumer-aware calculation path later; separate display/source quantization from threshold decisions.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Generic same-color text pairing and exceptions
Requirements.Description: Unclassified raw pairs are still treated as normal text. Three diff exclusions correct known cases, but XML Foreground/Background names are not a general content contract.
Requirements.Next: Restrict enforced content pairings to identified consumers; retain unknown pairings as screening evidence.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Hard-coded shell content and status context pairs
Requirements.Description: Four SystemFill status tokens are explicitly classified as normal text at 4.5 despite the documented stroke/border role. Other text pairings still require their declared underlays.
Requirements.Next: Split status strokes from message text and select actual neighboring surfaces before changing thresholds.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Context registry schema and source-contract enforcement
Requirements.Description: The module validates typed references, complete alpha chains and thresholds, but a confirmed-contract label does not require a rendering mode or traceable consumer evidence. Each of 69 entries is separately assessed.
Requirements.Next: Record consumer/rendering provenance in step 2; retain unresolved states until corroborated.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Registered editor RGB surfaces
Requirements.Description: The 52 registered components correctly require opaque RGB and use explicit fill/border/hatch kinds. Their thresholds are project requirements. This does not cover every editor color.
Requirements.Next: Retain these checks and extend only for a traced consumer. Check overlap and actual rendered states later.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Active legacy states and inherited overlay foregrounds
Requirements.Description: Selected accent and inherited-foreground relationships encode previous design decisions; eight registered overlay paths now require opaque RGB.
Requirements.Next: Keep raw/inherited types separate; confirm remaining legacy active consumers during runtime work.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Legacy text, links, surfaces and state pairs
Requirements.Description: Explicit role names improve classification, but many links and borders are checked against a shared secondary/tertiary surface rather than a traced parent.
Requirements.Next: For each member, inspect its control template and active/inactive parent chain; preserve source anchors pending evidence.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Disabled and decorative treatment
Requirements.Description: Disabled exemptions, a 1.5 discoverability advisory, and the stricter disabled scrollbar glyph rule are local policy. A non-focused enabled window is not a disabled control.
Requirements.Next: Keep disabled/active semantics distinct and label stronger project rules accordingly.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Neutral modern control and card ladders
Requirements.Description: The control ladder matches documented alpha tiers, with intentional palette-derived RGB. The three card tiers differ from current Dark reference values, contradicting the authoring guide's shared installed-Dark claim.
Requirements.Next: Correct provenance wording or conduct a later deliberate card review; do not silently copy Dark colors.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Legacy neutral fills and pressed-state distinctions
Requirements.Description: 0x18 neutral hover, dark pressed lifts, engaged-command accents and exact state distinctions are local design requirements.
Requirements.Next: Retain project intent; trace actual parent surfaces before promoting state-pair estimates to consumer evidence.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Strong borders, focus indicators and separator advisories
Requirements.Description: The semantic focus/stroke distinction is appropriate, but uniform secondary-surface tests do not establish all adjacency or focus states. PanelSeparator is correctly advisory.
Requirements.Next: Trace each declared focus/border consumer and its adjacent surfaces; retain separator estimates as advisory.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Razor, HTML, CSS and variable hierarchy
Requirements.Description: Semantic aliasing, opaque variable anchors, inherited members and OKLab separation are project design rules.
Requirements.Next: Retain family distinctions; keep named types and renderer semantics separate from color similarity.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Active editor selection content coverage
Requirements.Description: Core syntax surface checks omit active selection; only selected foreground and variables receive dedicated checks. Installed normal selection painting uses the background brush. Fifty-nine of 273 registered syntax/active-fill source pairs fail 4.5.
Requirements.Next: Extend the active-syntax matrix after confirming normal-selection presentation; keep high-contrast selection behavior separate.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Find and symbol marker semantics and prominence
Requirements.Description: The inspected marker contract distinguishes outline and fill. Border colors, borderless choices and OKLab strength floors are project requirements.
Requirements.Next: Retain consumer-scoped marker interpretation; verify intersecting markers and state precedence at runtime.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Current-line and inactive selection safeguards
Requirements.Description: Inactive fills have explicit opaque coverage. Current-line source pins exist for ten themes; remaining current-line checks allow composition and do not establish all types or overlap behavior.
Requirements.Next: Inspect CurrentLineActiveFormat in each unpinned theme and confirm brush/pen use and selection overlap before extending opaque assertions.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Amberroot statement and code-analysis overlays
Requirements.Description: Six checks enforce an alpha-composited normal-text model without a traced consumer. CodeAnalysisKeyEventSelection is simultaneously unresolved as F06-063 in the contextual registry.
Requirements.Next: Resolve each statement/analysis consumer, its RGB conversion and foreground meaning; remove contradictory confidence claims before remediation.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Core syntax anchors, markup coupling and distances
Requirements.Description: Exact family anchors and perceptual separation are local design policies; the Plain/Operator pair is exempt from the entire distance check, not only exact equality.
Requirements.Next: Document the actual exemption and retain explicit family/member lists. Active-selection gap is DR-016.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Hardline neutral edges and debugging exception
Requirements.Description: Quiet versus meaningful edges and the debugging-purple exception are approved design choices, not High Contrast system mode.
Requirements.Next: Preserve the explicit exception and avoid making a Windows High Contrast claim.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Shell base, headers, tool panes and Foundation neutral surfaces
Requirements.Description: Matching modern/legacy surfaces and Foundation charcoal are project cohesion rules. The reference does not require these equalities across custom themes.
Requirements.Next: Retain the approved neutral anchors; track modern and legacy consumer paths separately.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Legacy solution-name state treatment
Requirements.Description: The low-alpha active legacy title and separate inactive text are project relationships; modern badge validation is separate.
Requirements.Next: Preserve the separation; do not use a legacy title check to qualify the modern badge.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Layered document-tab/toolbar equality
Requirements.Description: A 0x4D layer, exact secondary/tab composition, lighter-than-base direction and 0.02 distance encode the custom design; the official default values do not establish a universal elevation ordering.
Requirements.Next: Retain as project policy with an explicit underlay and later visual verification.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Modern solution badge and shared toolbar frame
Requirements.Description: Installed templates confirm the token consumers and shared border. Exact title/toolbar fill equality is the user-approved project choice; official defaults differ.
Requirements.Next: Keep shared semantic binding and identify the exact candidate during future runtime review.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Resting and operational status bars
Requirements.Description: A 30% black resting band and darker-than-body direction are local styling constraints; operational text contexts are separate.
Requirements.Next: Preserve state distinctions and qualify the underlay in runtime evidence.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Scrollbar state ladder
Requirements.Description: 3/3.5/4.5 state ratios, increasing contrast, 0.03 distances and disabled arrow discoverability are stronger local policies rather than a WCAG state ladder.
Requirements.Next: Retain these thresholds as project decisions and verify DPI, glyph and adjacency effects later.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Extension Manager surface gap constraints
Requirements.Description: Shelf/list/page equalities and tight distances preserve historical source assumptions. Current nested consumer surfaces and runtime reachability are not established here.
Requirements.Next: Trace Cider/CommonDocument templates and compare the actual Extension Manager state against the retained measurements.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Per-theme palette pins and variant anchors
Requirements.Description: Named palette anchors and stable variants express the custom theme identities, including the approved Foundation review.
Requirements.Next: Preserve raw mappings and theme identities; open any later recolor as a separate reviewed change.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Editor hyperlink content and Output URL rendering
Requirements.Description: F04-043 assumes an alpha blend. Output urlformat defaults to bBackgroundValid=0, which removes the background brush; if a theme override supplies a valid background, the inspected conversion produces opaque RGB. Final override validity is unresolved. Thirteen RGB-branch ratios fail, while all thirteen ignored-background ratios pass.
Requirements.Next: Inspect final Output URL format properties and validity flags for the current package; register either inherited underlay or opaque RGB as evidenced. Do not bake a foreground-only item based on the conditional numbers.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Coverage reports, advisories and acceptance limits
Requirements.Description: Coverage output explicitly describes its bounded scope and retains unresolved results; inventory dispositions are not a complete map of specialized checks. Test success is not runtime acceptance.
Requirements.Next: Keep counters and evidence scopes separate, preserve historical artifact identities, and reconcile inventories in step 2.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Authoring/release workflow and documentation-only rules
Requirements.Description: Locked palettes, semantic editing, explicit generation, proportionate tests, runtime evidence and no token deletion by RGB coincidence are project maintenance requirements.
Requirements.Next: Retain these safeguards. Documentation claims with specific mismatches are separately linked to findings.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Known inline-diagnostic message and border contract
Requirements.Description: The version-matched Roslyn implementation sets message foreground, border background brush and transparent interior; F06-059 through F06-061 use the editor underlay.
Requirements.Next: Retain this contract and separate diagnostic URL links; overlap still needs runtime inspection.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.

Requirements.Title: Current notification window versus legacy notification pairings
Requirements.Description: The inspected UserNotificationsWindow item template uses ToolWindowText and ToolWindowBackground, with notification hover/selection brushes. It does not reference the registered legacy title/subtitle tokens.
Requirements.Next: Locate any alternate consumers of the legacy pairs; register the inspected template separately. Absence here is not proof the old tokens can be deleted.
Requirements.LocationScope: Item 1 baseline; line numbers are historical, not current execution selectors.
